stories.title: Verify the full Phase 1 acceptance set
stories.description: As a project owner, I want to review the integrated tools and complete course against their criteria, so that I can distinguish a finished MVP from partial demonstrations.

requirements.text: When full Phase 1 acceptance is evaluated, the release review shall reference evidence for every required feature.
If a required acceptance criterion fails, then the MVP epic shall remain open.

scenarios.name: Review complete scope
scenarios.given: all feature stories report completion with evidence
scenarios.when: the owner evaluates M4
scenarios.then: the review covers all eight tools, the complete accepted course and shared quality gates
scenarios.verification: Trace all requirement/scenario/task IDs to actual test/review evidence

scenarios.name: Reject incomplete MVP acceptance
scenarios.given: one required accessibility or privacy scenario fails
scenarios.when: the release review runs
scenarios.then: the failing story is reopened or blocked and the epic is not marked done
scenarios.verification: Controlled status-validator fixture plus real defect triage; no waived scope by calendar date

stories.title: Reproduce and document the local release candidate
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want to hand off a tested local release with known limitations, so that another person can reproduce the accepted result.

requirements.text: When a maintainer follows the local release instructions from a clean checkout, the application shall start using the documented configuration.
If a proposed release includes cloud deployment or account functionality, then the Phase 1 scope review shall reject that addition pending a separate decision.

scenarios.name: Reproduce the release
scenarios.given: the accepted commit and pinned prerequisites are available
scenarios.when: a maintainer follows the local runbook
scenarios.then: the application becomes healthy and the documented smoke checks pass
scenarios.verification: Fresh checkout/container run and recorded version identity

scenarios.name: Keep the release inside agreed scope
scenarios.given: the local release candidate is ready
scenarios.when: the release instructions are reviewed
scenarios.then: they contain no implied hosting, account setup or unauthorised publication step
scenarios.verification: Review runbook, known limitations and publication authorisation boundaries
